clips.title: The story
paras: Unnerving Silence concerns an abrupt loss of communication from a druid enclave nestled inside a cave in northeastern Shadowgale Forest. In the wake of Ban'aethall's ruin and growing regional unrest, an investigator is dispatched to locate Elegael Thornpaw and assess the conclave's fate.

A quiet unease hangs over the wilderness following the fall of Ban'aethall. With that village reduced to ruins and mysterious unrest stirring through the territory, established lines of contact have begun to fray. In particular, regular dispatches from a secluded druid conclave dwelling deep inside a cave in northeastern Shadowgale Forest have abruptly ceased, leaving their allies on edge.

Travelers heading toward Shadowgale Forest are tasked with tracking down Elegael Thornpaw, a prominent figure among the cave-dwelling druids. Venturing into the shadowed northeast, an investigator must discover whether the enclave has simply withdrawn into deeper communion with nature or succumbed to the same dangers that tore through Ban'aethall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A moment if you will, friend. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.
With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?
So the message did not get through. We are in dire straits indeed then.
It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
